items.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
items.abstract: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions. In DeepSeek’s own simulation, p95 task completion fell to 15.7
